item.title: Unmasking the Narrative: A Conversation w/ Dr. Ryan Cole [CrossPolitic Show]
item.description: In this eye-opening episode of CrossPolitic, we sit down with Dr. Ryan Cole, a leading pathologist and vocal critic of mainstream medical narratives. Dr. Cole shares his insights on the COVID-19 pandemic, health policy, and the challenges of navigating truth in a polarized world. This conversation cuts through the noise to explore the science, data, and broader implications for health freedom. Don't miss this compelling discussion.

item.title: War and Peace: In the Heart of Syria w/ James Rayment [CrossPolitic Show]
item.description: As rebels take key territories in Syria, the Assad regime faces collapse, and the country reaches a critical turning point. What does this mean for Christians caught in the crossfire? Will a rebel victory bring peace, or plunge Syria into deeper chaos? Join us as we unpack the conflict’s complexities, the role of international powers, and what’s next for a fractured nation.

item.title: Tulips on Fire: The Blazing Piety of the Dutch Calvinists w/ Ben Zornes [CrossPolitic Show]
item.description: In this episode of CrossPolitic, author Ben Zornes joins us to talk about his book Tulips on Fire, where he challenges the cold, lifeless view of Calvinism. Instead, he shows how the doctrines of TULIP should ignite a passionate pursuit of holiness. From the Synod of Dort to the fiery piety of the Dutch Reformation, Zornes dives into how figures like Wilhelmus á Brakel and Gisbertus Voetius lit a fire for godliness that still speaks to us today. If you think Calvinism is just dry theology, think again—this conversation will reignite your faith!
item.author: Gabe Rench, Chocolate Knox, Toby Sumpter

item.title: Peace on Earth: Taking God’s Blessings with Joy [CrossPolitic Show]
item.description: Joy to the world—or at least, joy in the midst of it! Whether it’s the weight of trials or the responsibilities that come with His gifts, we talk about taking it all with gratitude and faith. With Christmas as our backdrop, we dig into how true peace on Earth comes from trusting God’s plan, embracing His blessings, and finding joy in the journey He sets before us. And we remind ourselves why Christmas is the season of hope, even when the world feels heavy. Tune in for the laughs, the encouragement, and the call to live boldly, no matter the season!
